note: Cherokee County OK publishes no zoning district layer; its maps page offers only image files (county map, precincts). The largest city, Tahlequah, publishes its official zoning only as a PDF map (adopted Aug 16, 2022), with no queryable ArcGIS service found in searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub, the city site, and OK Maps. Third-party zoning sites (zoneomics) are not official.
